invalid_payload.label: Invalid validation payload
invalid_payload.description: The request body did not include a valid config object.

missing_pipeline.label: Missing pipeline block
missing_pipeline.description: The configuration must contain a pipeline object.

invalid_section_type.label: Invalid plugin section format
invalid_section_type.description: A plugin section is not encoded as an array.

invalid_plugin_item.label: Invalid plugin entry
invalid_plugin_item.description: A plugin entry is not an object.

missing_plugin_name.label: Missing plugin name
missing_plugin_name.description: A plugin entry must include a non-empty name.

unknown_plugin.label: Unknown plugin
unknown_plugin.description: The selected plugin name is not valid for that section.

missing_required_field.label: Missing required field
missing_required_field.description: A mandatory plugin field has not been provided.

unknown_field.label: Unknown field
unknown_field.description: The configuration contains a field that is not defined for the plugin.

ui_message.label: UI validation message
ui_message.description: The UI generated a local validation or status message.

pydantic_validation_error.label: Request validation error
pydantic_validation_error.description: The submitted request did not match the API contract.

lua_syntax_error.label: Lua syntax error
lua_syntax_error.description: Inline Lua code could not be parsed successfully.

lua_parser_unavailable.label: Lua validator unavailable
lua_parser_unavailable.description: Lua syntax validation could not run because the parser dependency is unavailable.

sql_syntax_error.label: SQL syntax error
sql_syntax_error.description: The Fluent Bit SQL processor query does not match the supported SQL subset.

sql_parser_unavailable.label: SQL validator unavailable
sql_parser_unavailable.description: SQL syntax validation could not run because the parser dependency is unavailable.

empty_input_file.label: Empty configuration file
empty_input_file.description: The selected configuration file does not contain any configuration content.

fluentbit_yaml_parse_error.label: Fluent Bit YAML parse error
fluentbit_yaml_parse_error.description: The Fluent Bit YAML file could not be parsed.

fluentbit_yaml_ignored_section.label: Ignored YAML section
fluentbit_yaml_ignored_section.description: Part of the Fluent Bit YAML file was skipped because the editor does not support that section yet.

fluentbit_yaml_invalid_section.label: Invalid YAML section
fluentbit_yaml_invalid_section.description: Part of the Fluent Bit YAML file was skipped because the section shape was not valid.

fluentbit_yaml_invalid_plugin.label: Invalid plugin entry
fluentbit_yaml_invalid_plugin.description: A Fluent Bit YAML plugin entry was skipped because it was not structured correctly.

unknown_issue.label: Validation issue
unknown_issue.description: A validation issue was reported without a known code mapping.
